Install the class table word at +0x00, then destroy members in reverse declaration order: release +0x38 through vtable slot +16 when non-null, release both array elements from the highest index down, release +0x1c through slot +16 when non-null, then forward self and the caller's flags to the base destructor. Preserve the null tests, the release order and the untouched flags argument. Inferred class identity; observed offsets only; no owned initialized data.
